en_quote: This module covers various money laundering risks associated with financial services.
knowledge_zh: 本模块概述金融服务中的洗钱风险

en_quote: The financial services sector is integral to the global economy, facilitating the movement and management of capital across borders.
knowledge_zh: 金融服务部门在全球经济中促进资本跨境流动

en_quote: Given its central role, this industry is particularly vulnerable to the risks of money laundering.
knowledge_zh: 金融服务业因其核心地位特别容易受到洗钱风险影响

en_quote: Understanding these risks is necessary for maintaining compliance, protecting the integrity of the financial system, and safeguarding institutional reputations.
knowledge_zh: 理解洗钱风险对维护合规、金融体系完整性和机构声誉至关重要

en_quote: By learning these topics, you will be equipped to identify vulnerabilities, implement effective controls, and manage and mitigate risks, ensuring your organization remains secure and trusted by customers.
knowledge_zh: 学习目标：识别漏洞、实施有效控制、管理并降低风险
